title: crataegus coccinea var. pruinosa
intro: Crataegus coccinea var. pruinosa, commonly known as Prickly Hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Prickly Hawthorn include cardiotonic, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects, which can help to lower blood pressure and improve circulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
